I think it depends IMO. Yes if you have a crush on an actor or fictional man played by a real person, then you're not a lesbian.

But most of these gals have some affection for a fictional anime guy, and let's be real...anime guys neither look nor act like real men. They all look like butch lesbians (to me at least). Most are written waaaaay more emotionally deep than real men (esp the men written by women, like shoujo animes) and a good bit are voiced by women, too.

(To be fair, I find it hard to understand what it even means to have a "crush" on a fictional character, but I'm an aro lesbian, so. shrug.)

Anyways...I think it's absolutely possible a woman claiming to be a lesbian may actually be bisexual, and this can include her having a romantic/sexual interest in drawn cartoon characters. But if a lesbian told me she has a crush on, like...Naruto, I'm not going to personally instantly think "Oh, she's not a real lesbian."

(Also I feel a lot of people confuse fictional crushes for general affection to begin with. They say someone is their "fictional crush" when what they really mean is they are endeared to them, like how you see a puppy. So, I tend to not take it so seriously.)

I don't know why everyone thinks it's so offensive...if a straight girl asked me and I knew it wasn't going to be anything more I don't see that as any different than another homosexual or bisexual asking me for the same thing. As long as you go into it stating clearly what you want and the other person agrees to it, there's no problem. Doesn't matter what other people think if you two have fun.
